name: Val & Paricha
description: Balanced three-cut combinations. A fresh block opens a perfect-parry window.

name: Kuntham
description: A precise thrust with exceptional reach. Aim carefully; its striking cone is narrow.

name: Kettukari
description: Broad, flowing sweeps. Heavy blows break an elite guard's defence.

name: Kattaram
description: Quick cuts and short recoveries. Close the distance before committing.

name: Urumi
description: A wide ribbon of steel. Powerful crowd control with a deliberate recovery.
